detail: Proposing a crosswalk requires TASKS.UPDATE, which is admin-only. Whether practising engineers (supervisors) should be able to propose candidate mappings is an authorization decision, not an architecture defect.
resolution: APPROVED FOR V1: reuse existing Knowledge governance capabilities. No crosswalk-specific permissions created. If implementation later proves these cannot represent the required separation of duties, raise a separate bounded authorization decision.

detail: Current proposal: crosswalks do not participate in Knowledge Pack publication and have no published state. Whether crosswalks must ever travel with a published pack is a product decision.
resolution: NO SEPARATE CROSSWALK PUBLICATION STATE FOR V1. approved is the terminal governed usable state; crosswalks do not participate in Knowledge Pack publication.

detail: Only industry is modelled structurally; jurisdiction and lifecycle phase are deferred to free text until evidence of need.
resolution: STRUCTURED APPLICABILITY FOR V1 IS INDUSTRY ONLY. No structured jurisdiction/lifecycle phase/manufacturer/model/service/customer/site/process without concrete future requirements.

detail: Hierarchical external codes are represented as an optional text path today. Whether a full external hierarchy is needed later is undecided.
resolution: EXTERNAL HIERARCHY STRUCTURAL MODELLING DEFERRED. classification_path is optional informative text, not a modelled hierarchy. Atiman must not become a mirrored standards database.

detail: The classification tables required to populate external_classification for these two authorities are not accessible. Architecture is unaffected; population is blocked until access exists.
resolution: Does not affect the architecture. Only population of external_classification for these two authorities is blocked until licensed access exists.

detail: activity_codes.iso_maintenance_reference and cause_codes.iso_failure_cause_reference carry unverifiable ISO14224-* lineage. Must NEVER be bulk-imported as trusted mappings; at most candidates requiring independent verification.
resolution: FALSE_PROVENANCE_REMEDIATION_REQUIRED recorded and strengthened. Existing values must not be treated as approved crosswalk knowledge, must not be migrated as trusted mappings, and must not be repaired under the M5R.3 record. Remediation is a separate bounded mission.

detail: Requiring at least one evidence row for an approved crosswalk is a cross-table rule and therefore remains a service/domain responsibility, consistent with migration 013 documented boundary. Must be enforced in the future implementation, not only documented.
resolution: Non-omittable implementation requirement: the future crosswalk implementation must enforce at-least-one-evidence for an approved relationship at the service/domain layer, consistent with migration 013 documented boundary.

detail: PROJECT_SOURCE_SYNCHRONIZATION_REQUIRED remains open (carried from M5R.2). No repository-resident Project Source exists, so no conflict could be evaluated.
